metrics.name: Heart rate
metrics.meaning: Heartbeats per minute.

metrics.name: HRV · RMSSD
metrics.meaning: Variation between successive beat intervals, using RMSSD. Compare the same method and measurement period.

metrics.name: HRV · SDNN
metrics.meaning: Standard deviation of normal beat intervals. This is a different quantity from RMSSD.

metrics.name: Skin conductance
metrics.meaning: Electrical conductance at the skin. This does not identify an emotion or its cause.

metrics.name: Skin temperature
metrics.meaning: Absolute temperature at the skin sensor, not core body temperature.

metrics.name: Skin temperature change
metrics.meaning: Change from the source baseline. This is not an absolute skin temperature.

metrics.name: Movement
metrics.meaning: Standard deviation of acceleration magnitude over the reported interval. This is not a step count.

metrics.name: Respiratory rate
metrics.meaning: Breaths per minute over the reported measurement interval.

metrics.name: Oxygen saturation
metrics.meaning: Oxygen saturation reported by the sensor, with its measurement method preserved.

metrics.name: Steps
metrics.meaning: Steps counted during the reported interval. Counts from overlapping sources are not added together.

metrics.name: Beat interval · RR
metrics.meaning: Individual beat interval reported by the heart-rate sensor. This is not an HRV score.

metrics.name: Pulse interval · PPI
metrics.meaning: Raw interval between optical pulse peaks; check the accompanying PPI sensor flags. Zero denotes unavailable. This is not an HRV score.

metrics.name: PPI error estimate
metrics.meaning: Error estimate supplied by the optical sensor for its pulse interval.

metrics.name: PPI sensor flags
metrics.meaning: Polar PPI flags: bit 0 invalid interval; bit 1 contact detected; bit 2 contact detection unsupported.

metrics.name: ECG
metrics.meaning: Raw electrical cardiac waveform. No rhythm classification is performed.

metrics.name: Blood volume pulse
metrics.meaning: Optical pulse waveform in source-specific arbitrary units. Values from different sensors are not interchangeable.

metrics.name: Body temperature
metrics.meaning: Temperature reported by a health thermometer. It is not automatically classified as skin or core temperature.

metrics.name: Sensor temperature
metrics.meaning: Temperature stream with unspecified measurement location. Do not equate this with skin temperature.

metrics.name: Barometric pressure
metrics.meaning: Atmospheric pressure reported by the sensor. This is not blood pressure.

metrics.name: Acceleration · X
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · X
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · X
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Acceleration · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · Y
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Acceleration · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw acceleration along the sensor axis, including gravity.

metrics.name: Angular velocity · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw gyroscope measurement along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: Magnetic field · Z
metrics.meaning: Raw magnetic field along the sensor axis.

metrics.name: PPG · 1
metrics.meaning: Raw optical sensor channel in source-specific units. No oxygen saturation or HRV is inferred.

metrics.name: PPG · 2
metrics.meaning: Raw optical sensor channel in source-specific units. No oxygen saturation or HRV is inferred.

metrics.name: PPG · 3
metrics.meaning: Raw optical sensor channel in source-specific units. No oxygen saturation or HRV is inferred.

metrics.name: PPG · ambient
metrics.meaning: Raw optical sensor channel in source-specific units. No oxygen saturation or HRV is inferred.
